text:
DNS::tsig
Description
This command manipulates the current DNS message and its TSIG resource
record.
Note
: This command requires the DNS Profile, which is only
enabled as part of GTM or the DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
tsig
exists
DNS
::
tsig
remove
DNS::tsig
exists
Returns a boolean for the TSIG’s existence in the message.
DNS::tsig
removes
Removes the TSIG from the message.
Examples
when
DNS_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
DNS
::
tsig
exists
]
}
{
DNS
::
tsig
remove
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
GLOBAL_GTM
